## Summary

Forward-testing milestone: the first options algo he designed — less than 3 months old — is doing well in paper. **+64% in 52 trading days, one options contract at a time.** The deliberately unsexy profile: **40% win rate, 1.72 profit factor** — losses are frequent, the payoff distribution carries it.

## Why it matters

- **The stats ARE the strategy thesis.** 40% win rate × 1.72 PF is the exact shape his public methodology predicts: negative-skew-tolerant, distribution-over-win-rate thinking — a live extension of the backtest discipline captured in [[2026-09-01-milk-man-backtest-notional-normalization]] and the replication standard in [[2026-08-29-milk-man-replication-metrics]].
- **52 trading days is forward-test evidence, not an edge.** The vault's existing skepticism path applies in full: one options contract at a time means sizing is trivially small; a 64% paper run over ~2.5 months is well inside what a favorable vol regime hands any short-premium-ish book. Track it as the forward-test leg of [[2026-09-17-milk-man-bilbo-box-article-teaser]], don't upgrade it.
- **Skepticism gates:** paper account, not live; single underlying per trade, unknown underlyings mix; PF and win rate are self-reported snapshot stats, no curve shown.
